finsights.brief: Holds more cash than debt on its balance sheet

summary: Geely Auto H1 2026 revenue of $97.25B missed forecast by 6%, but gross margin rose to 17.9% from 16.2% YoY; shares gained 4.77%.
Profit margin reached 5.6% vs. 1.6% industry average; Zeekr sales jumped to 100K units in Q2 from 77K in Q1 amid premium brand strength.
Q3 gross margin guidance set at minimum 18.4%; export volume surged to 270K units in Q2, with higher margins than domestic sales reported.
Leadership transition announced as Chairman An Conghui shifts from family-run model to institutional management; new CEO Gan Jiayue installed.
Major product pipeline includes Zeekr high-voltage models, Galaxy TT, and fifth-gen charging tech enabling 10-70% charge in under 4.5 minutes by Q3.
